query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intake.consent_record WHERE conversation_id = c.id) AS "consented!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intake.emergency_event WHERE conversation_id = c.id AND text_queued_at IS NOT NULL AND safe_at IS NULL) AS "waiting!", COALESCE((SELECT choice = 'emergency' FROM intake.intake_answer WHERE conversation_id = c.id AND question_id = 'emergency_choice' ORDER BY answered_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1), false) AS "emergency!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intake.property WHERE homeowner_id = c.homeowner_id) AS "area!" FROM intake.conversation c WHERE c.id = $1
